phase_name: Make the Hold Operator-Settable and Reversible

objectives.description: update-task-status.sh: target_status validation, usage, header comment for hold/unhold
map_status() preflight:hold arm + extended postflight-only comment
hold_reason/held_at/prior_status field writes on preflight:hold (fresh hold and reason-update cases)
preflight:unhold dynamic STATE_STATUS preamble + del() field clearing
hold-sticky guard (scope addition -- see plan deviation note) so an ordinary forced preflight write never clears an existing hold
test-update-task-status.sh: Cases 12-16 (set, missing-reason, lift round trip, missing-prior_status, sticky guard) + source-store-first override for the three touched files

deviations.description: Plan's Phase 3 files-to-modify list named only update-task-status.sh and its test; implementation added generate-todo.sh (render the Held line) and a hold-sticky guard inside update-task-status.sh beyond the plan's literal task bullets.
deviations.reason: The rank-based monotonic-max clamp does not protect an unranked status like hold, so the plan's own Phase 2 claim ('hold's persistence is a property of Phase 3's map_status() work') required an actual guard, not just the hold/unhold arms. generate-todo.sh rendering was needed to make the TODO.md '- **Held**:' line (named by Phase 1 and Phase 3's task text) real rather than aspirational.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added generate-todo.sh rendering and a hold-sticky guard; see plan Phase 3's Deviation note)*
